_comment: Aurel Voss, the Last Arbiter. His three phases and the laws he keeps in each are here; how he fights is in gameplay/actors/voss.gd. He yields; he is not killed.
name: Aurel Voss
title: The Last Arbiter

phases.name: Arraignment
phases.says: You will be heard. One rule at a time.

phases.name: Cross-examination
phases.says: Two rules now. Mind them both.

phases.name: The Hearing
phases.says: Then let it be a hearing. It binds me as it binds you.

boss.yields: Enough. I have seen what you are. Take my licence, or refuse it.
